subtitle: Every single day with you is a gift. Please open the envelope below...
letterP1: Happy 1st Anniversary! Today is a celebration of us, but I also want to take this moment to say I'm truly sorry for the mistakes I've made. Sometimes I take your gentle patience for granted, and I regret any time I've brought a shadow to your face.
letterP2: You deserve the absolute world, and I promise to listen closer, support you deeper, and love you better every day. Thank you for being my light and my home.
balloonMessages: I love the way your eyes sparkle when you are genuinely happy. ✨
Happy Anniversary! You are the absolute best thing that ever happened to me. 💖
I'm sorry for being stubborn sometimes. I promise to listen closer and hold you tighter. 🌸
My favourite place in the entire world is next to you, laughing at nothing. 💫
You are my sweet girl, my best friend, and my greatest adventure. Happy 1 Year! 🌹

flowers.title: A Bouquet of Sweetness
flowers.description: A beautiful arrangement of your favourite flowers (roses and pink peonies) to show how much you brighten my days.

earrings.title: A Token of Promise
earrings.description: Sterling silver earrings chosen with love. Inspired by that sketch of us choosing earrings together on a cozy street corner.

date.description: A special invitation reserved just for the two of us, to celebrate properly.
